The place

Big flavour.
Straight from the grill.

Tandoori Nights BBQ is a family-friendly spot in Robertsham serving the kind of food that belongs around a busy table — smoky BBQ, tandoori chicken, biryani and comforting sides.

Whether you're grabbing a quick meal or sitting down with family, the focus is simple: hot food, generous flavour and a welcoming atmosphere.
